good.text: {book} did just what I needed. Thank you kindly.
Did you hear? {name} has been singing the library's praises all over the market.

unhelpful.text: Did you hear? {name} says the library's books are all charm and no use.

harmMisuse.headline: Damage reported on the Hollin road
harmMisuse.text: Damage was reported overnight on the Hollin road. The constable has questions and few answers.
Did you hear? Something nasty happened out by {name}'s place. Nobody's saying what.

harmAccident.text: Did you hear? {name} had an accident with a charm. Lost a shed. Nobody hurt.
Something in {book} went wrong. I'd rather not say what. I'll bring it back.

mixedMisuse.headline: Odd doings on Lantern Street
mixedMisuse.text: Neighbours report an unusual week on Lantern Street, though none will say quite what they mean.

mixedAccident.text: {book} worked — mostly. I'd rather not talk about the rest.
